claimed_purpose.text: LMEB is a named benchmark registered within the MTEB framework, invokable by name to retrieve a fixed task list for evaluation of embedding models.

mechanisms.text: Primary retrieval metric is R_cap@k (capped recall at k), defined as the number of relevant documents in the top-k results divided by min(total_relevant, k), yielding a value in [0,1] that caps the denominator at k to avoid penalizing queries with many relevant documents.
LMEB spans 22 datasets and 193 zero-shot retrieval tasks across 4 memory types: episodic, dialogue, semantic, and procedural, with both AI-generated and human-annotated data.
One named task visible in the default task list is 'LoCoMo', suggesting long-context or conversational retrieval tasks are included.
Default primary metric is ndcg@10; an alternative metric R_cap_at_10 is also supported via the summarization script.

ledger.claim: Dialogue tasks use candidates.jsonl to constrain retrieval to per-conversation history rather than full corpus
ledger.quote: in dialogue settings, a query is evaluated only against its corresponding conversation history, rather than the full corpus, ensuring evaluation under realistic access constraints.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Datasets include a mix of AI-generated and human-annotated sources; semantic tasks predominantly use human-annotated content
ledger.quote: Many episodic, dialogue, and procedural memory retrieval tasks incorporate a mix of AI-generated and human-annotated data, ensuring that models are tested on both synthetic and real-world data. In contrast, semantic tasks predominantly rely on human-annotated content, ensuring genuine datasets for knowledge retrieval.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Weighted Jaccard Similarity formula used for inter-dataset diversity: J(S,T) = sum_k min(S_k,T_k) / sum_k max(S_k,T_k)
